text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here we go! This one's about the
Entwinement, yeah? And this
one... should
be about sole slates, I think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It looks to be... a record kept
by a slate artisan. "Autumn.
Divers artisans
met together for to gather wood
wherewith they
fashioned sole slates."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So back then artisans used to gather
'round and all make the slates
together?
Also, I dunno how you can make heads or
tails outta this
mess of squiggly lines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's a hobby, you could say. I can't do
much without my calligraphy
handbook,
but I'm glad to finally put these skills to
use.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"With raised voice... dancing flame... to
dispel evil in the bowstring's
stead...
thundering feet... lost connections strung
together... shining
as one..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...This part seems important. I should take
notes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gahh! There's so many pages left. This
might be enough readin' for a
lifetime...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But there's no time to rest! Let's see here...
"The roots of the Heartfire
Ceremony
remain shrouded in mystery, though one
convincing theory
holds that..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This drawing looks like running
Umamusume. They're side by side, so I

guess it's the Procession? They ran it with
a lot more Bearers than we
do now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oops. Almost fell asleep. Focus, focus...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few study sessions later, boot camp is
already drawing to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, why don't we go over what
we've all learned from the
documents we
read?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So the Heartfire Ceremony, it started out
as a ritual prayer to the
Three Goddesses
for the fortunes of Umamusume, but then
racing
culture changed it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It went from bein' about good fortune to
prayin' for safety and
success in races. So
basically, it wasn't about the past at
first—it was
about the future.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Later, the prayers of retired Umamusume
gave rise to the new
dedicatory aspect of
paying homage to the glory and struggles
of
their forerunners.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So it was a wish for the future, then
expanded to include a prayer for
the past,
which connected past and future...
Something like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The Heartfire Ceremony
connects past, present, and
future, tying
together the wishes of all Umamusume
across time—to
rephrase what you said.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...So all the different rites have their own
meaning, some sort of wish
or prayer
behind them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was ignorant of the prayers demanded in
each, yet I had the gall to
force my
assumptions of what a Bearer ought to be
onto the
ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Your assumptions? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well... In my head, a Heartfire Bearer
was the centerpiece of a
historic ritual,
and as such must embody purity and
gravitas.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And if I could do that... if I could be that
kind of Heartfire Bearer...
then I could
stand proud.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But to do so would be no more than
performing my own ego. What's
truly
important is embodying the prayers at the
heart of the
ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't much better. I was so focused on
my goal of winnin' a
bunch, all I could
think about was makin' this a success no
matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And I guess I needed a hefty dose of
respect for our forerunners. All I
was
thinkin' about was makin' it a grand ol'
time... Boy do I feel dumb.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I think I understand now... What it was we
lacked. The voices we
should have heeded
all this time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guys? If it's okay with you, there's
something I want to ask Ms.
Mukai about...

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
You want to know the feelings of
Umamusume who ran in the past?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As I studied up on the ceremony, it made
me want to know more. All
those
Umamusume from the past—what prayers,
what wishes did they
have?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I only had this fuzzy notion
that it would be nice to
perform the duty
of a Heartfire Bearer for the folks alive
today. That's
all I had coming into this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But now, there's more. I want to be the
best Bearer I can be for the
Umamusume
of the past, too. Could you help me?

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. There is something I can show
you. I think you're all
ready to see it now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What are these books?

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
In your hands are the sole slates burned in
past ceremonies. The
wishes of
participating Umamusume have all been
copied down and
compiled.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I will allow you to borrow them, so please
give them a read.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a second! You sure we can look
at these?!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeing as you are grappling with what
it means to be a Heartfire
Bearer, I'm sure
you'll find them to be useful.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I ran for so long, only to fall short in the
one graded race that really
mattered. I still
dream of what could've been."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"So I pray on behalf of some future runner
I'll never know, that she'll
be able to win
the race she really wants to win."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So there were Umamusume prayin'
for us. For the victories of
folks in the
future just like us.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I had to give up racing early on. Although
I was able to make a name
for myself off
the track..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"If things had gone my way, I would've
wanted to gain fame through
running too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I don't blame her. If you choose to race,
there's nothin' you want
more than to
announce yourself to the whole world with
your runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I had a strong rival—and friend—who I
wished to compete with on
the big stage.
However, unforeseen circumstances
suddenly took her
out of racing."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The hole in my heart left by her departure
remains unfilled. I pray
that no one need
suffer this misery in the future."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I lost a worthy opponent so dear to me,
just like she did... What
would I do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want anyone else to know this
feeling. The pain of being one
step away
from becoming the best in Japan, only to
have your legs
give out on you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"So I pray... that no one else becomes like
me. That no one else feels
the
unquenchable thirst I now feel."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... I can only imagine the cold depths
of her despair... It saddens
me. I will finish
what you started, if you'll allow me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Running for the folks who supported me,
winning for them—it was
pure bliss. And
when I made it on the cover of that
magazine, they
were all so happy, and so
was I."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I pray that the Umamusume of the future
experience this joy as well."
I guess there
were always Umamusume who ran for the
sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So many runners... and their dreams live on
here... And now... now, I...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we're all done reading. Heh,
everyone's makin' the same
face—now this
is a sight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That includes you, too, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Say, before the final rehearsal, there's
something I wanna hash out
with you guys.
